title: Caption-aware linked-audio ripple TrimClip
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: TrimClip(ripple:true) on a document that already has a persistent audio track now delegates to the existing RippleTrimClip path: linked members ripple together, and captions and markers use the same interval crop/split/shift. It is not refused as CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and is not rewritten as LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

A spanning cue keeps authored text; the portion inside the closed interval is cropped and the portion after is shifted. Source uncover is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. A locked partner is FIELD_LOCKED. Out-trim caption geometry matches RippleTrimClip (remnant ids may differ). An in trim still pins timeline start.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, adds a spanning cue, uses Ripple trim out for 15 frames, undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in. The same persist path is also exercised with TrimClip(ripple:true) through the SDK.

Leave-gap TrimClip still does not shift later content and still leaves an absolute remnant in the vacated gap. MoveClip with captions still refuses CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. DeleteClip(ripple:true) on a linked pair still refuses LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED without captions and CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED when captions exist. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen RippleTrimClip, video-only TrimClip(ripple:true), reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, split and leave-gap rebind/remnants, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, linked ripple delete, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
